test_case_metadata.name: Unpaid Salary - Resigned Full & Final Delay (Gurugram)
test_case_metadata.user_message: My name is Priya Nair. I was working as a Senior Product Analyst at Apex Retail Media Pvt Ltd in Cyber City, Gurugram. I resigned on July 31st after completing my full 60-day notice period. They were supposed to clear my FnF settlement of Rs. 1,85,000 within 45 days. It has been over 90 days now and HR has stopped responding to emails. I have my Offer Letter, Resignation Acceptance, and No-Dues Clearance certificate.
test_case_metadata.intent: Tests clean corporate wage dispute with complete facts in one turn. Triggers immediate Legal Notice of Demand under Section 73 Contract Act & Payment of Wages/IBC.

conversation_history.content: My name is Priya Nair. I was working as a Senior Product Analyst at Apex Retail Media Pvt Ltd in Cyber City, Gurugram. I resigned on July 31st after completing my full 60-day notice period. They were supposed to clear my FnF settlement of Rs. 1,85,000 within 45 days. It has been over 90 days now and HR has stopped responding to emails. I have my Offer Letter, Resignation Acceptance, and No-Dues Clearance certificate.

✅ **Aapke sabhi zaroori facts verify ho chuke hain.**

**Aapki Kanooni Sthiti (Legal Standing):**
Bhartiya shram kanoon aur contractual rules ke mutabiq:
1. Kaam ki gayi avadhi ka vetan (earned salary) aapka kanooni adhikar hai. Company client payment delay ya fund ki kami ka bahana banakar salary nahi rok sakti.
2. Salary na milna ek civil aur labour matter hai, samanyata isme criminal FIR (jaise 420) nahi banti jab tak shuruat se hi dhokhadhadi ka irada na ho.
3. Notice period poora hone ya resignation ke baad, company ko Full and Final settlement niyamit samay me karna anivarya hai.
4. Aap poora baaki vetan byaj (interest) sahit maangne ke haqdaar hain aur Labour Commissioner ya Civil Court me Summary Suit ke jariye claim kar sakte hain.

Maine aapke liye ek Formal Legal Notice of Demand draft kar diya hai. Aap ise verify karke samne wali party ko Speed Post, WhatsApp, ya Email ke zariye bhej sakte hain.

state_snapshot.legal_notice_draft:
**FORMAL LEGAL NOTICE OF DEMAND FOR UNPAID SALARY AND DUES**
*(Sent via Registered Email / Speed Post)*

**Date:** 07 November, 2026

**To:**
**The Management / Directors**
**Apex Retail Media Pvt Ltd**
Address: Cyber City, Gurugram

**From (Sender):**
**Priya Nair**
Designation: Senior Product Analyst

---

**SUBJECT: FORMAL DEMAND NOTICE FOR PAYMENT OF OUTSTANDING SALARY AMOUNTING TO RS. 185000/- AND ISSUANCE OF SERVICE DOCUMENTS**

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions and on behalf of myself, **Priya Nair**, I hereby issue this Formal Notice of Demand regarding the illegal withholding of my legitimate earned remuneration:

1. **EMPLOYMENT & ROLE:** That I was employed with **Apex Retail Media Pvt Ltd** at your **Cyber City, Gurugram** office as **Senior Product Analyst**. My employment is evidenced by valid documentation including official Offer Letter, appointment records, and salary statements.

2. **SERVICE & SEPARATION:** That I discharged my professional duties diligently. My employment status is **resigned**, having fulfilled all contractual obligations including handover.

3. **DEFAULT IN PAYMENT:** That despite continuous service and multiple reminders, you have unlawfully withheld and failed to disburse my earned salary for the period of **Full & Final (FnF) settlement post resignation**, aggregating to a total outstanding sum of **Rs. 185000/-**.

4. **LEGAL LIABILITY:** That salary earned is a fundamental property right under law. Unilateral withholding under pretexts such as client delays or operational fund deficits is illegal and constitutes a clear breach of contract under Section 73 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, as well as applicable labour welfare statutes.

5. **DEMAND (15 DAYS NOTICE):** You are hereby called upon to remit the entire outstanding dues of **Rs. 185000/-** along with my Relieving Certificate and Full & Final statement directly to my designated bank account within **fifteen (15) days** from the receipt of this notice.

6. **CONSEQUENCE OF DEFAULT:** Please note that if you fail to comply with this demand within the stipulated period, I shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings before the competent Labour Court/Authority, file a Summary Suit for Recovery under Order 37 CPC with interest, and explore statutory remedies under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016, holding your company and its officers liable for all costs and consequences.

**Sender:**
**Priya Nair**
